text:
leena: Noticed a cluster onboarding failure in ap-south-2 after the new outbound FQDN lockdown landed. Several nodes stuck in init.
ops-bot: Alert: node-join-failures x18 in prod-ap-south-2. Ticket created AUTO-9182.
harry: paste from node init log: "keystore: decrypt: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = AccessDenied". TCP shows attempts to 10.240.5.42:443 (privatelink ENI).
sid: we intentionally tightened egress to only allow kms.ap-south-2.amazonaws.com domain. But our keystore resolves to privatelink ENIs -> traffic never egresses to public KMS host. Bad assumption on my part.
leena: can we patch quickly? We lost ~12 GPUs from warm pool, impacting some dedicated capacity jobs.
jules: short-term fix: adding a targeted allow for the endpoint ENI CIDR 10.240.5.0/24 in the egress ACL for ap-south-2 AZ B. Will scope the change to the join cohort only. Running: `./infra/terraform apply -target=aws_network_acl.privatelink_allow -var=az=ap-south-2b`
ops-bot: infra change queued by jules (CI-run 9821). Plan OK.
harry: after the NACL update, join rate improved: +9 GPUs back within 6 minutes. Still reconciling the rest of the warm pool.
leena: cost delta: routing those IPs via NAT increases SNAT table use; rough daily estimate for AZ mirroring is $150/day. Not huge but non-trivial if permanent.
sid: longer-term options on the table: 1) maintain a service that lists endpoint ENIs and updates allowlists; 2) switch keystore to use security-group-restricted privatelink (associate SG to endpoint and permit SG-to-SG traffic); 3) use route-based egress (hairpin via dedicated endpoint VPC). Thoughts?
jules: option 2 seems clean: manage SG associations for the endpoint and let node SGs allow that SG. Avoids IP churn problems. Implementation task: update endpoint ownership + terraform provider support for SG attach.
harry: we also lacked visibility: flow logs for that endpoint subnet are low-sample and not in the SIEM index. We couldn't easily trace why nodes were hitting 10.240.5.x vs public kms hostnames.
leena: immediate follow-up: increase VPC flow log sampling to 100% for endpoint subnets and route logs to secure-siem/logs-priv. sid, can you take?
sid: on it. Will flip sampling and create a short retention tier with 30d full logs + cheaper archive after.
ops-bot: Change applied: vpc-flowlog-sampler set to 100% for subnet-privatelink-ap-south-2b.
jules: FYI we should also add an integration test in infra-ci that resolves keystore.svc.privnet from a joiner instance to ensure we don't roll FQDN-only policies without accounting for endpoints.
harry: opened INF-2250: "privatelink ENI-aware egress and SG association." Assigned to @eng-platform and @eng-security.
leena: small note on deploy hygiene: the PR description for the FQDN-lockdown said it would "allow privatelink via hostnames" — that phrasing set the wrong expectation. We need to update the egress policy runbook and preflight checklist (DNS resolution test).
sid: I'll draft a checklist item: "confirm internal endpoints that resolve to ENIs are whitelisted via SG/ENI/CIDR prior to FQDN-only egress enforcement."
jules: follow-up RFC incoming from infra to add an endpoint-controller + terraform bridge. Will demo a PoC next Tue.
leena: great. Marking this SEV3 and keeping monitoring window for 2h. Thanks everyone.
ops-bot: Alert resolved: node-join-failures (18 -> 0) at 2026-03-23T09:46:50Z.
harry: will post a short incident note in INF-2250 with timeline and cost numbers. Closing thread for now.
